title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Dispute Window and Response Time
content:
Two time limits frame an invoice dispute on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record. The dispute window counts the calendar days, starting from the date an invoice bears, that the billed party has for challenging it. The response time counts the calendar days, starting from the dispute itself, that the line has for reaching its decision.

| Product | Dispute window | Response time |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 45 calendar days | 30 calendar days |

**Q: Does the contract product give longer to respond to a dispute?**
No. It gives the billed party a longer window to raise a dispute, 45 days instead of 30, while the line's response time is 30 days throughout the range.
